objective: Implement strict source-public observation and legal 7-action event transport to native future 7-action experimental learner, without silently modifying R7/R8/R9 fixed 3-action API or inventing state fields.
public_sensor_contract: Only original env.gen_obs() dict keys image (7x7x3 public agent-centric encoded view), direction (int 0..3), mission (exact DoorKey mission). Key in hand is visible at agent view cell per upstream gen_obs_grid; nearby door encoded as door type/state from actual public view, no env.carrying/env.grid/global coordinates.
rules: reject hidden fields/extra keys, malformed type/range, unsupported view or mission; no privileged environmental state
reject out-of-range/invalid action, duplicate in-flight submission, illegal postterminal transitions, inconsistent role/pairing
emit exact chosen action, public-before/public-after hashes, public directly observed carrying and front door deltas, explicit unknown pose rather than oracle forward movement
allow only source-returned numeric reward, terminated/truncated flags; capture source-public outcome before next action
public observations may normalize original NumPy image to plain list; no Grid/worldobject private handles
bounded action ledger, deterministic JSON digest, distinct fresh Python process checkpoint restore, corruption rejection
7-action adapter never routes action 3/4/5/6 through R7-R9 3-action acceptors
source-only tests use authored public pixel arrays as fixtures; NOT original source environment execution or scientific first use
compare independent conventional public-observation parser on exactly same fixture visibility, no stronger information baseline
complete Linux/Windows source-only focused tests and separate G29 generated-atlas check, no protected promotion
scientific_claim: Engineering public observation/action compatibility only; NOT evidence of learned unlocking, task success, action consequence prediction or native superiority.
